plugins.name: fable-advisor
plugins.description: Read-only Fable advisor subagent for decisions, plan reviews, stalled debugging and change-set verification — tracks the newest Fable release via the fable alias (Fable 5.2 today), with Opus fallback when Fable is unavailable. Enforcement hooks inject the advisor policy every session, gate ExitPlanMode on a consultation, hold unadvised multi-file turns for review, and enforce consultation inside background worker subagents.

plugins.name: advisor-select
plugins.description: Pick which model advises the current session — e.g. main conversation on Sonnet, second opinions from Opus. Session-scoped selection with fallback and substitution detection.

plugins.name: pause-resume
plugins.description: Freeze a running agent between tool calls and thaw it later with full context intact — for moving locations, losing connectivity, or sleeping the laptop mid-task. Auto-resumes when the network returns, and rebuilds resume briefs from the transcript when a session is cut off.

plugins.name: feature-crew
plugins.description: Turns one Claude Code session into an orchestrator: features and revisions you ask for are built by background feature-builder subagents, each on its own git branch in an isolated worktree, while the main conversation stays free. The orchestrator routes each feature to a Sonnet, Opus or Fable worker by a fixed procedure, climbs at most once to Fable when checks still fail, and a model-check hook confirms each worker ran on the model chosen for it and records its token use. The main session keeps a roster, relays workers' questions to you, resumes them with your answers, and reports when each one is done.
